title: ReplaceFileContentTool
description: Atomically replaces a single contiguous block of code in an existing file using exact target matching with line range bounds.

TargetFile.description: The absolute canonical filesystem path to the target file. Relative paths are forbidden.

StartLine.description: The 1-indexed starting line number of the search boundary containing the target content.

EndLine.description: The 1-indexed ending line number of the search boundary containing the target content.

TargetContent.description: The exact character sequence to be replaced, including exact leading whitespace, indentation, and newlines. Must be uniquely identifiable within the [StartLine, EndLine] slice.

ReplacementContent.description: The complete replacement code string to be substituted in place of TargetContent.

Instruction.description: A concise technical description of the exact refactoring performed.
